items.summary: Update the StripeSetup component (frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx) to display a visual status indicator showing whether Stripe has been configured. Display a green checkmark icon with 'Stripe Configured' text when a valid Stripe secret key is stored in the backend.

Add a backend method hasStripeConfiguration() or extend the existing getStripeConfig() method in backend/main.mo to return a boolean flag or status indicating whether a Stripe secret key has been stored, without exposing the actual key value.
